headline: Amazon shares fall as third-quarter spending soars on AI infrastructure
summary: Amazon reported spending over $77 billion on property and equipment in Q3, exceeding analyst estimates as the company expands data centers to meet artificial intelligence demand.
why: Amazon.com, Inc. is a global e-commerce and technology company operating Amazon Web Services (AWS), the leading cloud infrastructure provider.

impacts.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
impacts.why: Capital expenditure exceeding expectations pressured cash flow expectations and profit margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher-than-expected capital expenditure on artificial intelligence infrastructure weighed on profit margins.
